_what_this_is: The retraction declaration for {{artifact.slug}}. It is the needle set CHECK-16 hunts: every figure or claim this artifact has WITHDRAWN, in every spelling it could have been written in. It is machine-read, so it is JSON rather than prose, and it is committed, so the scan is reproducible from this directory alone.
_why_an_empty_list_is_a_real_answer: An artifact that withdrew nothing still declares that it withdrew nothing. `retracted: []` with a review date is a dated, committed statement that somebody looked; the file being ABSENT is not, and CHECK-16 refuses that as a did-not-run rather than passing over it. A clean scan of a tree nobody reviewed is a sentence, not a measurement.
_fill_in_reviewed_on: TODO(artifact:retractions) -- replace the empty `reviewed_on` below with the date you reviewed this artifact, as YYYY-MM-DD. It is deliberately NOT stamped at generation time: a date the generator wrote would agree with everything by construction and the check that reads it could never fail.
_needle_rules: A figure has more than one spelling and a needle that knows only one of them reports a zero that means nothing, so list every form: 0.9882 and 98.82% are two needles, not one. A BARE-NUMERIC needle is adjudicated against its digit boundaries -- a match sitting inside a longer number is a false positive, counted and never a finding -- so prefer a needle carrying its unit where one exists. A WORD-FORM needle should carry `context_terms`: without them, ordinary English matching the phrase reads as a live claim.
